variant_note: Polish K9PL = K9A1 base (Batch I: 48 ex-Korean K9GF + new builds; Batch II adds laser warning, fire suppression, AC, smoke launchers, APU in the hull). Not the 3-crew K9A2.

armament.main: 155 mm / 52 cal. Hyundai WIA CN98 howitzer, autoloader, 48 rounds, up to 6 rpm
armament.secondary: 12.7 mm heavy machine gun (K6) on the roof

protection: All-welded steel hull, resists 152 mm HE fragments and AP mines; optional spall liner and add-on armour; CBRN filtration
silhouette_features: large, tall box-like welded turret at the rear of the hull with a flat bustle
long 52-calibre barrel with a double-baffle muzzle brake, overhanging the hull front
low, short hull front with the driver at front left and the engine to the right
six dual road wheels per side with three return rollers, front drive sprocket, rear idler
commander and gunner hatches on the turret right with a roof MG, single door on the turret left
large rear hull door for ammunition resupply

image_candidates.note: Polish K9, Bemowo Piskie, 31 March 2023 (US National Guard photo)
ROK Army K9, by Kwon Sun-sam / Defense Citizen Network (Korean, not Polish)
